verdict.rationale: Greptile offers some retention control. Customers can turn off logging to make chats private, and self-hosting (Docker Compose or Kubernetes, including air-gapped setups) keeps logs on customer servers only. However, the vendor reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data and use it for AI training, and nothing describes deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented data deletion or purge capability, configurable retention periods for the hosted service, an opt-out from de-identified-data AI training, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
